```{r cells}

library(ggplot2)

cells <- read.csv('/Users/meganyoumans/Desktop/Adelphi Coursework/Statistical Modeling/Datasets 2/Datasets/Cell_Inhibition_Schoenfeld.csv')

summary(cells)

##Inhibitor, Assay, Cell.line, VHL, Replicate., Condentration.uM, PercentSurvival 

cellslm <- lm(data=cells, cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor + cells$Assay + cells$Cell.Line + cells$VHL + cells$Replicate. + cells$Concentration.uM)
summary(cellslm)

str(cells)

concentrate <- as.factor(cells$Concentration.uM)

cellsmod <- aov(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor + cells$Assay + cells$Cell.Line + cells$VHL + concentrate)

summary(cellsmod)

TukeyHSD(cellsmod) 

cellstukey <- TukeyHSD(cellsmod)
cellstukey$concentrate

cellsmod2 <- aov(cells$PercentSurvival ~ concentrate + cells$Inhibitor + cells$Assay + cells$Cell.Line + cells$VHL)
summary(cellsmod2)

TukeyHSD(cellsmod2)


ggplot(cells) + aes(x = PercentSurvival, y = concentrate, fill = Assay) + geom_boxplot()

ggplot(cells) + aes(x= PercentSurvival, y=concentrate, fill = VHL) + geom_boxplot()

##Results

##Concentration of the solution played a significant role in cell percent survival, especially at 20-4 concentration levels. Cell percent survival was less at higher concentration levels. 

```
